name: Survey tile in Taurus
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.9 degrees south of the ecliptic in Taurus, imaged by SPHEREx 16 times in 6 visits over 68 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 30 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.9 days starting 2026-02-13, at wavelengths from 0.97 to 4.64 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
